card.name: Inside brand and generic drug names
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of drug names split into parts, such as "ner" in neratinib, "UR" in ALDURAZYME, and "I" in JARDIANCE. The next piece of the name is still to come.

modes.label: Generic name, middle piece
modes.description: The piece "nir" or "ner" partway through a generic kinase inhibitor name like niraparib or neratinib.
modes.example: abemaciclib, apalutamide, dasatinib, encorafenib, ibrutinib, ivosidenib,<< ner>>atinib, nilotinib,

modes.label: Brand name, middle piece
modes.description: An upper-case piece inside a brand name like ALDURAZYME or JARDIANCE.
modes.example: Withhold JARD<<I>>ANCE for at least 3 days,

card.writes: It seems to push toward continuing a half-written name with its remaining letters, though the promoted tokens are unrelated.
card.plain: It fires inside a drug name that is still being spelled out, before the name is finished.
